_comment: Static sample witness input for the Viche vote circuit. gen_input.js generates a real input.json under build/ at runtime; this file documents the schema and is used by the README/docs.
pathIndices: 0 or 1 at level 0 (0 = our node is left child)
voteId: <the on-chain pollId, reduced into the BN254 scalar field>
merkleRoot: <root of the Poseidon Merkle tree of identity commitments>
